title: Input schema for ZoneOfTools Content Crawler
description: Crawl the ZoneOfTools PDF to Word Converter page and extract its website content.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Enter the URL of the website page you want to crawl. The crawler will start from this URL and extract its content.

crawlerType.title: Crawler type
enumTitles: Raw HTTP client with JS execution (JSDOM)
crawlerType.description:
Select the crawling engine:
- **Headless web browser (Chrome + Playwright)** - Recommended for modern websites that use JavaScript. It renders the page like a real browser.
- **Raw HTTP client (Cheerio)** - Faster and cheaper, but may not work correctly with JavaScript-heavy websites.
- **Raw HTTP client with JS execution (JSDOM)** - Executes JavaScript using JSDOM. This option is experimental.

maxCrawlDepth.title: Max crawling depth
maxCrawlDepth.description: The maximum number of link levels the crawler will follow from the start URL. The start URL has depth 0. Set this to 0 to crawl only the specified start URL.

maxCrawlPages.title: Max pages
maxCrawlPages.description: The maximum number of pages to crawl. The crawler will automatically stop after reaching this limit.

includeLinks.title: Include links
includeLinks.description: Extract links found on the crawled page.

includeImages.title: Include images
includeImages.description: Extract image URLs found on the crawled page.

removeNavigation.title: Remove navigation and footer
removeNavigation.description: Remove common navigation menus, headers, footers, and other boilerplate elements to focus on the main page content.
